filing_note: 20-F for FY2025 of Lithium Argentina AG (formerly Lithium Americas (Argentina) Corp.), CIK 0001440972. Note: this is the Argentine-only entity post the Oct 2023 Separation; Thacker Pass / GM / DOE loan are with the SEPARATE NewCo (Lithium Americas Corp., a different company under a different CIK). Cohort metadata referencing Thacker Pass/DOE/GM applies to NewCo, not to this filer.

claims.claim_text: Cauchari-Olaroz achieved commercial production on October 1, 2024 (operational lithium carbonate plant in Jujuy, Argentina, joint with Ganfeng via Minera Exar).
claims.subject: Lithium Argentina / Minera Exar
claims.source_quote: Minera Exar determined that commercial production was achieved at the Cauchari-Olaroz project as of October 1, 2024.

claims.claim_text: For 2026, Cauchari-Olaroz is expected to produce between 35,000 and 40,000 tonnes of lithium carbonate on a 100% basis, with realized prices in Jan/Feb 2026 averaging ~$17,000/tonne.
claims.subject: Cauchari-Olaroz
claims.source_quote: For year 2026, Cauchari-Olaroz is expected to produce between 35,000 and 40,000 tonnes of lithium carbonate on a 100 % basis ... realized lithium carbonate prices increased to an average of approximately $ 17,000 per tonne in January and February 2026.

claims.claim_text: Material uncertainty / going-concern language: auditor flagged substantial doubt depending on ability to repatriate Cauchari-Olaroz cash flows to service current portion of long-term debt.
claims.subject: Lithium Argentina AG
claims.source_quote: gives rise to material uncertainty which may cast significant doubt (or substantial doubt as contemplated by Public Company Accounting Oversight Board ( PCAOB ) standards) on the Company s ability to continue as a going concern.

claims.claim_text: Subsequent event (March 2026): Company entered a 6-year $130M debt facility with Ganfeng (SOFR + 2.5%), secured by interest in proposed Salta JV, with offtake of up to 50% / 6,000 tpa LCE to Ganfeng.
claims.subject: Lithium Argentina AG / Ganfeng
claims.source_quote: the Company entered into a six-year $ 130,000 debt facility with Ganfeng bearing interest at SOFR plus 2.5 % ... the Company has agreed to allocate up to 50 % of its offtake from the initial development phase of the New JV, capped at 6,000 tonnes per annum of lithium carbonate equivalent, to Ganfeng at market prices.

claims.claim_text: October 3, 2023 Separation transferred Thacker Pass and the North American business (including the GM transaction derivative) to a new Lithium Americas Corp. ('NewCo'); the filer has no further interest in NewCo.
claims.subject: Lithium Argentina AG (pre-Separation: Lithium Americas Corp.)
claims.object_value: Thacker Pass + $275.5M cash + GM derivative to NewCo
claims.source_quote: on October 3, 2023, the Company transferred its North American business, including, among other assets, the Thacker Pass Project ( Thacker Pass ) and $ 275,499 of cash to Lithium Americas (NewCo). ... The Company has no further interest in Lithium Americas (NewCo) subsequent to the Separation.

claims.claim_text: Pozuelos-Pastos Grandes and Sal de la Puna lithium brine projects in Salta, Argentina, proposed to be combined into a new joint venture with Ganfeng (initial development phase planned).
claims.subject: Lithium Argentina AG / Ganfeng
claims.object_value: Pozuelos-Pastos Grandes + Sal de la Puna (Salta, Argentina)
claims.source_quote: the proposed joint venture transaction with Ganfeng to combine the Pozuelos-Pastos Grandes and Sal de la Puna lithium brine projects in Salta, Argentina.

claims.claim_text: Convertible Notes classified current as of Dec 31, 2025; total contractual financial liabilities of ~$297.7M (incl. $261M convertibles), against $61.1M cash and $23.2M receivables.
claims.subject: Lithium Argentina AG
claims.object_value: Current convertibles + accounts payable vs $61.1M cash
